info.title: CampusWari API
info.description: Campus social platform. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Errors are `application/problem+json` (see the Problem schema); 429 carries `Retry-After`.

FieldProblem.description: One invalid field. Never contains the rejected value.

Problem.description: Every error response (RFC 9457, application/problem+json). Branch on `code`, never on `detail`.

errors.description: Only with VALIDATION_FAILED: the invalid fields.

errorId.description: Only with INTERNAL_ERROR: quote it to support.
